name: allocait
description: Check a portfolio, or a change to it, against its own written allocation rules, work out the amounts that close a gap, and keep holdings, cash, rules, watchlists and playbooks current, through the Allocait MCP connector. Allocait never places trades or gives investment advice; every check runs against rules the user declared themselves.

allocait_api_key.title: Allocait API key
allocait_api_key.description: Your Allocait agent API key, from Settings > Agents in the Allocait app. A Core plan key reads and checks; an Advanced plan key can also change data. Sent only as the x-api-key header on calls to Allocait's own MCP server. See the README for connecting by sign-in instead.
